title: Ferrocene thiazolidine-2,4-dione derivatives cause DNA damage and interfere with DNA repair in triple-negative breast cancer cells.
authors: Vukea, Nyeleti; Oderinlo, Ogunyemi; Tukulula, Matshawandile; Khanye, Setshaba David; Edkins, Adrienne Lesley; de la Mare, Jo-Anne
one_liner_zh: 该文研究二茂铁噻唑烷二酮衍生物诱导三阴性乳腺癌细胞DNA损伤并干扰修复，涉及小分子与DNA小沟结合及对接分析，但对象为小分子-DNA而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: In this study, ferrocene-containing thiazolidine-2,4-dione derivatives were screened against triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) cell lines, which represent an aggressive subtype of the disease predominant in women of African descent. The lack of key receptors in TNBC poses a therapeutic challenge as there are limited targeted treatment options available for this subtype. The ferrocene thiazolidine-2,4-dione derivatives displayed toxicity against HCC70 TNBC cells in the low-moderate micromolar range (5-46 muM) and two compounds were selected for further study, with IC50 values of 7.54 +/- 1.07 muM (OY25) and 5.59 +/- 1.24 muM (OY29). Additionally, compounds OY25 and OY29 were screened against other cancer and non-tumourigenic cell lines and found to be less toxic against non-cancerous breast epithelial cell line MCF-12A (SI = 2.2188 and 4.4359, respectively) compared to the HCC70 TNBC cell line. Compounds OY25 and OY29 show a dual mode of action involving increased reactive oxygen species generation and induction of DNA damage. In silico docking analysis and competitive DNA binding fluorescence-based assays revealed that the compounds disrupt key DNA damage phosphoprotein levels through binding to the minor groove of DNA. In a combination assay, the compounds acted synergistically and antagonistically with DNA damage-inducing drugs, camptothecin and etoposide, respectively. Meanwhile, in combination with PARP-1 inhibitor, OY25 and OY29 acted synergistically and antagonistically, respectively. Furthermore, in silico results, using the SwissADME web tool, showed that the compounds OY25 and OY29 display desirable ADME (absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion) profile with parameters within acceptable range.
abstract_zh: 本研究中，含二茂铁的噻唑烷-2,4-二酮衍生物针对三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）细胞系进行了筛选，该疾病是一种侵袭性亚型，主要影响非洲裔女性。TNBC缺乏关键受体，这给治疗带来了挑战，因为针对该亚型的靶向治疗选择有限。二茂铁噻唑烷-2,4-二酮衍生物对HCC70 TNBC细胞表现出低至中等微摩尔范围（5-46 μM）的毒性，并选出两种化合物进行进一步研究，其IC50值分别为7.54 ± 1.07 μM（OY25）和5.59 ± 1.24 μM（OY29）。此外，化合物OY25和OY29还针对其他癌细胞系和非致瘤细胞系进行了筛选，发现与HCC70 TNBC细胞系相比，它们对非癌性乳腺上皮细胞系MCF-12A的毒性较低（选择性指数（SI）分别为2.2188和4.4359）。化合物OY25和OY29表现出双重作用机制，涉及增加活性氧生成和诱导DNA损伤。计算机模拟对接分析和基于荧光的竞争性DNA结合实验揭示，这些化合物通过结合DNA小沟来破坏关键DNA损伤磷酸蛋白水平。在联合实验中，这些化合物分别与DNA损伤诱导药物喜树碱和依托泊苷表现出协同和拮抗作用。同时，与PARP-1抑制剂联合使用时，OY25和OY29分别表现出协同和拮抗作用。此外，使用SwissADME网络工具的计算机模拟结果显示，化合物OY25和OY29展现出理想的ADME（吸收、分布、代谢和排泄）特性，参数均在可接受范围内。
